changelog: YOUR NEXT MOVE ASKS BEFORE IT COMMITS. Tapping a blue node on the expedition map used to march the column instantly — it now tells you what the node is and what to expect, and waits for Accept or Cancel. Also included since 0.0.62: the draw / discard / exhaust pile viewers, upgraded rules text on all 56 new cards (they were printing their un-upgraded rules), three new commander medals, forward placement for upgraded Build cards, and a long list of fixes — Overstrength was unusable from the hand, Load Balancing was eating a third of the damage it claims only to spread, free cards showed full price and greyed themselves out, and the raider announced itself before you could see it.
